svg.title: Thirty Microclimates — Venissa Walled Garden
svg.desc: Four-panel analysis of Venissa's walled garden microclimate system on Mazzorbo island, Venetian Lagoon. Panel 1: Site context. Panel 2: Wall effects (wind shadow, thermal mass, humidity). Panel 3: Section through garden with temperature zones. Panel 4: Microclimate map with 30 distinct zones.
svg.text: TWO ACRES OF WALLED GARDEN · 2.5m BRICK WALLS · 88 DORONA VINES · 30 DISTINCT GROWING CONDITIONS
from Bora winds by mainland arc
2.5m Brick Walls · Thermal Mass · Wind Shadow · Humidity
South-facing walls absorb heat all day;
release it slowly at night. Creates
near wall base where condensation forms.
Zones 1–6: North wall shadow · Coolest · +5% humidity
Zones 25–30: South wall sun trap · Warmest · Early ripening
Center zones: Most stable · Lowest diurnal swing
"Each zone is a distinct growing condition —
the vineyard is a mosaic of microclimates"
Data: Venissa estate records · ISTAT climate data · C1_microclimates · dorona_vine.json
